data: Exact standard/other table values and ordering from the published mime 4.1.2 distribution, including starred conflict preferences. No runtime download or MIME database dependency.
implementation: Reimplemented lookup and transactional definition logic. Built-in state is locked privately and inspection returns copies. Both module systems and frozen extension arrays are supported.
storageCompatibility: Storage 8.4.0 uses getType; mime 3.0.0 retained as migration control. MIME data follows 4.1.2, not historical assignments.
